name: deetechgroup
description: DeeTech Group website — Next.js public site + admin CMS, Express API, PostgreSQL

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@deetech/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@deetech/api && npm run build --workspace=@deetech/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@deetech/shared-types && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@deetech/shared-types && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run redirects:build && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
